channel.title: Pier & Point · Madrone
channel.description: Changes, corrections and dated milestones for Madrone (Mission Bay), San Francisco. Every item names its source.

item.title: Correction · Madrone: The Assessor's 2012 year built is a tax-roll value, not a completion or opening date; the Department of Building Inspection recorded the final-inspection permit complete on October 27, 2014 and the new-construction permit complete on November 12, 2014.
item.description: The Assessor's 2012 year built is a tax-roll value, not a completion or opening date; the Department of Building Inspection recorded the final-inspection permit complete on October 27, 2014 and the new-construction permit complete on November 12, 2014. Source: https://data.sf.gov/resource/i98e-djp9.json?permit_number=201305167126; https://bosadevelopment.com/project/radiance-madrone-mission-bay/.

item.description: Madrone now uses its Assessor lot lines. Source: DataSF Assessor parcels (acdm-wktn), lot 8720117.

item.title: Correction · Madrone: The Madrone page now says Bosa describes Radiance as the first major condominium development in the US after the 2008 market downturn and says only that Madrone's towers were completed 'a few years later', with no year. The Assessor's 2012 is a roll year, not a completion event, and SocketSite's mid-2012 move-in (2010) was an expected date. No source gives Madrone's opening date.

item.title: Correction · Madrone: The map notes gave 329-330 units, an architect and an opening of 2011-2012 that Bosa's project page does not support (it gives 693 units for three buildings combined, no architect, and only 'a few years' after 2008). Those statements were withdrawn in a dated note, the completion milestone moved from June 2011 to 2012 per the DataSF Assessor roll, the 2010 milestone now cites its SocketSite post, and the OSM tag citation was corrected from addr:housename to name.
item.description: The map notes gave 329-330 units, an architect and an opening of 2011-2012 that Bosa's project page does not support (it gives 693 units for three buildings combined, no architect, and only 'a few years' after 2008). item.title: Complete · Madrone: Madrone (420 and 480 Mission Bay Blvd N, 435 China Basin St) completed: the DataSF Assessor roll gives year built 2012 for its condominium lots (a roll year, not a completion event), and Bosa says its two connected towers were completed 'a few years' after Radiance, which it calls the first major condominium development in the US following the 2008 market downturn (Bosa gives no completion year) (~2012)
item.description: Madrone (420 and 480 Mission Bay Blvd N, 435 China Basin St) completed: the DataSF Assessor roll gives year built 2012 for its condominium lots (a roll year, not a completion event), and Bosa says its two connected towers were completed 'a few years' after Radiance, which it calls the first major condominium development in the US following the 2008 market downturn (Bosa gives no completion year) (~2012). Source: https://data.sf.gov/resource/wv5m-vpq2.json?block=8720; https://bosadevelopment.com/project/radiance-madrone-mission-bay/.
